newsitem.title: USA: Greenway group holds 8.7 pct Monarch stake.
newsitem.headline: Greenway group holds 8.7 pct Monarch stake.

text.p: A group including Greenway Partners L.P. said Monday it has acquired an 8.7 percent stake or 327,600 common shares in Monarch Machine Tool Co.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $3.2 million for the stake.
It said it bought the stake because it believes Monarch's shares are undervalued.

It intends to monitory closelly developments in the company, especially the search for a new chief executive and implementation of advice to the company by Lehman Bros concening ways to maximize shareholder value, it said.
